about: Light-performance scores for every cut Digital Gemology sells, computed by our light-census ray tracer. Diamond and moissanite are scored separately; never compare or rank across materials. Scores are unrounded; status 'not yet scored' rows carry a reason instead of scores.

cuts.name: Heart
cuts.reason: The census traces convex stones, and the heart’s notch makes it concave.

cuts.name: DG-Cabochon
cuts.reason: This stone has no table, so the head-on light measure we use for the other cuts does not apply.
